title: Wren and the Colony
author: Freya Brightwater
blurb: Gideon Vasquez, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
